turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on am, is and are?
turns.tutor:
Yes! Look at this first. "It ___ hot." Who or what? "It". "It" takes "is". So: "It is hot."
So the rule: am with I, is with he, she and it, are with you, we and they.
Right: "You are kind." Wrong: "You is kind."
Now you try. Write just the missing word:
Write am, is or are: I ___ a student. (answer with only the missing word)
